facts_used: TRD-20261118-666F5516 is marked trd_done. Revision 2 records the user's approval of the eight requirements presented in revision 1. The TRD specifies three ordinary-prompt checks and identifies no open question or assumption.

U1 describes premature handoffs. U2 requests completion, recovery, useful partial delivery, ownership, handoff and three checks. U3 specifies the reusable and active installations.
